title: Diagnostics: what may leave the phone
subtitle: Opt-in crash reports behind one reporter and a redaction layer (P014d1a, ADR 0028). The screens arrive with P014d1b and P014d1c

nodes.label: A typed event: SMS_SEND_FAILED, SERVICE_KILLED, RECOVERY_SHOWN, LOCATION_UNAVAILABLE, API_ERROR, ALERTS_GIVEN_UP
A caught error, or a crash nobody caught
Never reported: an SOS start or success, contacts, searches, routes, positions, texts, a user id
Redaction: the message is replaced by class name + category; keys only from an allowlist
Send crash reports? A setting on the phone, off by default. A debug build also needs its flag
DiagnosticsLog: the last 20 categories with a time, in memory only
CrashlyticsBackend: the only file that uses the library. Unsent reports are deleted before collection starts
Firebase Crashlytics (Google): stack trace, phone model, Android and app version, an install id
Choice off: nothing is collected or sent
Report a problem (P014d1c): the person reads the text and sends it themselves
